findings.evidence: grep: A.lean:485 `k ∈ typeASimpleSupport n ↔ (k : ℕ) < n`, B/Datum.lean:517 and D.lean:367 the same statement with the same `rw [.., mem_simpleSupport]; constructor; rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; simpa only [.._val] using i.isLt; exact fun hk => ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, Fin.ext ..⟩` proof; E6.lean:434 and C/Datum.lean:748 the same statement over `Finset.univ.map ⟨e, he⟩`, which is the body of `simpleSupport` (Basic.lean:60-61).
findings.fix: Replace the five bodies with the general lemma, e.g. `private lemma mem_typeASimpleSupport {k} : k ∈ typeASimpleSupport n ↔ (k : ℕ) < n := mem_simpleSupport_iff_lt typeASimpleIndex_injective typeASimpleIndex_val`, and likewise for B, D (passing `hn`), E6 and C (the last two after spelling their support as `simpleSupport _`).
findings.issue: `mem_simpleSupport_iff_lt` is added to the shared home but derives only the E₈ special case (E8/Datum.lean:226); the identical fact is still hand-proved in the siblings, whose hypotheses already match: A.lean:484-490 (`typeASimpleIndex_injective`, `typeASimpleIndex_val` at A.lean:351), B/Datum.lean:516-522 (`typeBSimpleIndex_val` at B/Datum.lean:255), D.lean:366-372 (`typeDSimpleIndex_val`), and, via the defeq `Finset.univ.map ⟨e, he⟩` spelling of `simpleSupport`, E6.lean:434-441 and C/Datum.lean:748-755. A general lemma with one consumer and five surviving copies of its proof is the wrong level in the shared file.

findings.evidence: Dual.lean:53 `variable {n R : Type*} [Fintype n] [CommRing R]`; mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Mul.lean:84 `dotProduct_comm [AddCommMonoid α] [CommMagma α]`, :761 `dotProduct_mulVec [Fintype n] [Fintype m] [NonUnitalSemiring R]`, :1089 `mulVec_transpose`.
findings.fix: Split the `variable` block: state `vecMul_dotProduct_comm` with `[NonUnitalCommSemiring R]` (keep `[CommRing R]` for `reflect_vecMul_dotProduct_self`, which genuinely subtracts).
findings.issue: `vecMul_dotProduct_comm` is stated under the section's `[CommRing R]`, but its proof uses only `dotProduct_mulVec` (`[NonUnitalSemiring]`), `dotProduct_comm` (`[AddCommMonoid] [CommMagma]`) and `mulVec_transpose`; nothing needs negation or a unit. In a general-purpose matrix file this blocks the semiring uses Mathlib's own dot-product API supports.

summary: The E₈ material sits at the right level and the shared reflection/symmetry lemmas are genuinely type-independent, but the new general `mem_simpleSupport_iff_lt` is applied only to E₈ while five identical special-case proofs remain in the sibling files, and `vecMul_dotProduct_comm` is stated over `CommRing` where only a non-unital commutative semiring is used.
